paragraphs: Travelzoo (including its subsidiaries and affiliates, the "Company" or "we") is a global Internet media company. We operate Travelzoo®, the club for travel enthusiasts, Jack's Flight Club®, and Travelzoo META. We reach 30 million travelers. Club Members, who pay a membership fee, receive Club Offers negotiated and rigorously vetted by our deal experts around the globe. Our relationships with thousands of top travel suppliers—give us access to irresistible deals. Our club and its benefits are built around the lifestyle of a travel enthusiast.

Travelzoo attracts a high-quality audience of travel enthusiasts across multiple digital platforms, including email, websites, social media and mobile applications. We have over 4.7 million social media followers on Facebook, Instagram, X and WeChat and, to date, our iOS and Android mobile applications have been downloaded 8.1 million times.

Our most important products and services are the Travelzoo website (travelzoo.com), the Travelzoo iOS and Android apps, the Top 20® email newsletter, Standalone email newsletters, the Travelzoo Network, and Jack's Flight Club®. Our Travelzoo website and newsletters include Local Deals and Getaways listings that allow our members to purchase vouchers for offers from local businesses such as spas, hotels and restaurants. Jack's Flight Club is a subscription service that provides members with information about exceptional airfares.
Thousands of travel and local providers use our advertising and marketing services.
The Company generates revenue from advertising and commerce, membership fees, and other sources.

Advertising revenue consists primarily of (a) advertising fees paid by travel companies for the publishing of their offers on Travelzoo's media properties, (b) commissions and revenues generated from the sale of Getaways vouchers and bookings on our hotel platform, and (c) publishing fees from high-quality local businesses, sale of Local Deals vouchers and entertainment offers. We typically recognize advertising revenues upon delivery of emails or clicks, as tracked by our internal platform or third-party platforms. We recognize revenue upon the sale of vouchers, upon notification of the amount of direct bookings or upon delivery of emails. We recognize a percentage of the face value of vouchers upon the sale of the vouchers, net of an allowance for refunds.

Membership fee revenue consists of subscription fees paid by Travelzoo and Jack's Flight Club. Travelzoo membership has historically been free, however, on January 1, 2024, Travelzoo introduced an annual membership fee of $40 (or local equivalent) for new members in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Germany, with the 2024 annual fee waived for existing members as of December 31, 2023. On January 1, 2026, we increased the annual membership fee to $50 for new members in the United States only. For existing Club Members, the new pricing will apply from the next renewal of their membership after February 1, 2026. Jack's Flight Club subscription options are quarterly, semi-annually, and annually. We recognize subscription revenues ratably over the respective subscription periods.

Other revenue consists of licensing fees from license agreements, as well as the retail business originally operated by Metaverse Travel Experiences LLC ("MTE") and acquired and maintained by the Company following the acquisition of MTE.

We also license Travelzoo products, services and intellectual property to licensees in (a) Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore and (b) Japan and South Korea, in each case, where the Company is entitled to quarterly royalty payments based on a percentage of net revenue. The Company recognized $68,000 and $71,000 in royalties in 2025 and 2024, respectively. Under the licensing agreements, Travelzoo's existing members in the applicable territories continue to be owned by the Company.

The Company has four reportable operating segments: Travelzoo North America, Travelzoo Europe, Jack's Flight Club and New Initiatives. Travelzoo North America consists of the Company's operations in the U.S. and Canada. Travelzoo Europe consists of the Company's operations in France, Germany, Spain, and the UK. Jack's Flight Club consists of subscription revenue from premium members to access and receive flight deals via email or mobile applications. New Initiatives consists of Travelzoo's licensing business, Travelzoo META and MTE. For the year ended December 31, 2025, Travelzoo North America operations comprised 66% of revenues, Travelzoo Europe operations comprised 28% of revenues and Jack's Flight Club operations comprised 6% of revenues.
Our principal business office is located at 590 Madison Avenue, 35th Floor, New York, New York 10022.
As of December 31, 2025, there were 10,932,337 shares of common stock outstanding.

Ralph Bartel, who founded Travelzoo, is the sole beneficiary of the Ralph Bartel 2005 Trust, which is the controlling shareholder of Azzurro. Azzurro is the Company's largest shareholder and, as of December 31, 2025, holds approximately 33.5% of the Company's outstanding shares. Holger Bartel, the Company's Global CEO, is Ralph Bartel's brother and did not hold any of the Company's outstanding shares as of December 31, 2025.
Travelzoo is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol "TZOO."

headings: Risks Related to Our Financial Condition and Business Model
We cannot assure you that we will be profitable.
Fluctuations in our operating results may negatively impact our stock price.
Expansion of product offerings may result in additional costs that exceed revenue and may trigger additional stock price volatility.
Our voucher products may be adversely impacted by competition and changing consumer demand for vouchers.
Impairments of goodwill, long-term investments and long-lived assets have a negative impact on our results of operations.
Our business could be negatively affected by reliance on digital platforms and changes in search engine algorithms or other traffic-generating arrangements.
Trends in consumer use of mobile devices continue to create challenges.
We may have exposure to additional tax liabilities.
Adverse application of state and local tax laws could have an adverse effect on our business and results of operation.
Our business model may not be adaptable to a changing market.
If we fail to retain existing advertisers or add new advertisers, our revenue and business will be harmed.
If our advertisers and content do not meet the needs and expectations of our members, our business could suffer.
"Cookie", "pixel" and tracking technology laws could negatively impact the way we do business.
Our reported reach may be higher than the actual reach and may not be representative of the number of persons who are active potential customers.
We may not be able to obtain sufficient funds to grow our business and equity or debt financing may be on adverse terms.
We may be sensitive to recessions or other macroeconomic circumstances or events affecting the travel industry generally.
Our operations could be significantly hindered by the occurrence of a natural disaster or other catastrophic event.
We are subject to payments-related and fraud risks.

Our financial results may be adversely affected by changes in United States generally accepted accounting principles, and we may incur significant costs to adjust our accounting systems and processes to comply.
Risks Related to Our Markets and Strategy
Our international operations may result in operating losses and are subject to other material risks.
We may not be able to continue developing awareness of our brand names.
If we fail to retain our existing members or acquire new members, our revenue and business will be harmed.
We may not be able to attract travel and entertainment companies or Internet users if we do not continually enhance and develop the content and features of our products and services.
Our business and growth will suffer if we are unable to hire and retain highly skilled personnel.
Intense competition may adversely affect our ability to achieve or maintain market share and operate profitably.
We may not be able to access third-party technology upon which we depend.

Acquisitions, investments, licensing arrangements and joint ventures could result in operating difficulties, dilution, and other harmful consequences that may adversely impact our business and results of operations.
The pre-purchasing of vouchers and hotel inventory could create additional risks or liabilities for our business.
Because we recognize revenue from subscriptions for our club membership over the term of the subscription, downturns or upturns may not be immediately reflected in our operating results.
Risks Related to Legal Uncertainty
We may become subject to shareholder lawsuits over alleged securities violations due to volatile stock price.
We are subject to laws and regulations worldwide, changes to which could increase the Company's costs and individually or in the aggregate adversely affect the Company's business.
The CARD Act and similar state and foreign laws may harm our Local Deals and Getaways business.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. The business, financial condition and operating results of the Company can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, including but not limited to those described below, any one or more of which could, directly or indirectly, cause the Company's actual financial condition and operating results to vary materially from past, or from anticipated future, financial condition and operating results. Any or all of the risks listed below, as well as other variables affecting our operating results, in whole or in part, could materially and adversely affect our business or financial condition, which could cause the market price of our stock to decline or cause substantial volatility in our stock price, in which event the value of your common stock could decline. You should also keep these risk factors in mind when you read forward-looking statements.

In the year ended December 31, 2025, we generated consolidated net income of $5 million, of which $4.7 million income was attributable to Travelzoo. In the year ended December 31, 2024, we generated consolidated net income of $13.7 million, of which $13.6 million income was attributable to Travelzoo. We forecast our future expense levels based on our operating plans and our estimates of future revenues. In the future, depending on various factors, including but not limited to, market conditions, changes in the general economy and the travel industry, we may need to cut expenses to preserve profitability or, alternatively, we may find it necessary to significantly accelerate expenditures to acquire Club Members. We may also expand, upgrade and/or add technology and make investments in existing or new products that may impact our profitability. If our revenues grow at a slower rate than we anticipate or decline, or if our spending levels exceed expectations or cannot be adjusted to reflect slower growth, we may not be profitable.

Our quarterly and annual operating results may fluctuate significantly in the future due to a variety of factors that could affect our revenues or our expenses in any particular period. You should not rely on quarter to quarter comparisons of our results of operations, as they are not considered an indication of future performance. Factors that may affect quarterly results include: level of investment in member acquisition, consumer refund rate; mismatches between resource allocation and client demand due to difficulties in predicting client demand; changes in general economic conditions (perceived or actual) that could impair consumer spending; the introduction, development, timing, competitive pricing and market acceptance of our products and services and those of our competitors; our ability to attract, hire and retain key personnel; our ability to maintain merchant and member satisfaction and continue to attract high-quality merchants and members; our ability to manage our planned growth; our ability to encourage member engagement with our products and services and convert non-paying members to Club Members; our ability to encourage renewals and retention of Club Members; and technical difficulties or system downtime.

We may significantly decrease our operating expenses in response to changes in general economic conditions, performance and/or declines in consumer demand. We may significantly increase our operating expenses for a certain period if, among other reasons, we see a unique opportunity to accelerate our acquisition of new members or engagement of existing members. If revenues fall below our expectations in any quarter and we are unable to quickly reduce our operating expenses in response, our operating results would be lower than expected and our stock price may fall.

On January 1, 2024, we moved to a paid membership model, with existing Travelzoo members grandfathered in through the end of the year. Since then, we have introduced additional Club Member benefits. In March of 2022, we announced the creation of our Metaverse business. We plan to include Metaverse travel experiences as a benefit of Travelzoo membership in 2026. The voucher product typically has a 14-day refund policy, but we may in the future alter or update the product, including refund windows, or invest in upgraded technology or new technology or products. Such product modifications and expansions may result in an increase in costs in the near-term and an increase in cost structure in the long-term, which may be in excess of incremental revenue. If we are unsuccessful in our efforts to monetize these initiatives, our business and financial results could be adversely affected. If we cannot attract members to our product offerings or our advertisers do not embrace the changes in our product offerings, our financial results could be affected. We can give no assurances that any of our product offerings will yield the benefits we expect and will not result in additional costs.

Our Local Deals and Getaways products include the sale of vouchers directly to consumers to advertise promotional offers provided by merchants. In some instances, we pre-purchase vouchers/hotel rooms in bulk. The voucher format may require additional investments to maintain and grow the business. Our vouchers typically have a 14-day refundability period and also have a surcharge option. However, since before 2021, we have seen a general decline in demand for voucher products. It is possible in the future that the Company may strategically move away from offering the surcharge option or vouchers in general, or the Company may invest further in voucher offerings to expand them from a product perspective. While we are continually evolving our strategy, we may not always be successful in doing so and the demand for our vouchers may decline or refund rates may increase and may adversely impact revenues.

The Company determines its reportable segments based upon the Company's chief operating decision maker managing the performance of the business. The Company currently has four reportable operating segments: Travelzoo North America, Travelzoo Europe, Jack's Flight Club and New Initiatives. Travelzoo North America consists of the Company's operations in the U.S. and Canada. Travelzoo Europe consists of the Company's operations in France, Germany, Spain and the U.K. Jack's Flight Club consists of subscription revenues from premium members to access and receive flight deals from Jack's Flight Club via email or mobile applications. New Initiatives consists of Travelzoo's licensing business, the Travelzoo META subscription service and MTE. For the year ended December 31, 2025, Travelzoo North America operations comprised 66% of revenues, Travelzoo Europe operations comprised 28% of revenues and Jack's Flight Club comprised 6% of revenues. Financial information with respect to our business segments and certain financial information about geographic areas appears in Note 11–Segment Reporting and Significant Customer Information to the accompanying consolidated financial statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this report is incorporated herein.

When evaluating the financial condition and operating performance of the Company, management focuses on financial and non-financial indicators such as growth in the number of members to the Company's newsletters, operating margin, growth in revenues in the absolute and relative to the growth in reach of the Company's publications measured as revenue per member and revenue per employee as a measure of productivity.
Revenues from the Travelzoo brand and business are generated primarily from three categories: Advertising and Commerce, Membership Fees, and Other.

The "Advertising and Commerce" category consists primarily of (a) advertising fees paid by travel companies for the publishing of their offers on Travelzoo's media properties, (b) commissions and revenues generated from the sale of Getaways vouchers and bookings on our hotel platform, and (c) publishing fees from high-quality local businesses, sale of Local Deals vouchers and entertainment offers. Advertising fees may be based on audience reach, placement in email newsletters or on media properties, number of listings, number of clicks, and/or actual sales. We typically recognize advertising revenues upon delivery of emails or clicks, as tracked by our internal platform or third-party platforms, in the period of the applicable insertion orders, which are typically for periods between one month and twelve months and are not automatically renewed. For Getaways vouchers, we recognize a percentage of the face value of vouchers upon sale as commission, net of an allowance for future refunds. Merchant agreements for Getaways advertisers are typically for periods between twelve and twenty-four months and are not automatically renewed. Revenues generated from local business offers are based upon a percentage of the face value of the vouchers sold, commission on actual sales or a listing fee based on audience reach. We recognize revenue upon the sale of vouchers, upon notification of the amount of direct bookings or upon delivery of emails. For Local Deals vouchers, we recognize a percentage of the face value of vouchers upon the sale of the vouchers, net of an allowance for refunds. Insertion orders and merchant agreements for Local Deals are typically for periods between one and twelve months and are not automatically renewed.

paragraphs: Travelzoo（包括其子公司及關係企業，以下稱為「本公司」或「我們」）為一間全球網路媒體公司。我們經營 Travelzoo®，這是一間為旅遊愛好者所設立的俱樂部，Jack's Flight Club®，以及 Travelzoo META。我們觸及 30 百萬位旅客。俱樂部會員需支付會費，以獲得由我們全球專門經紀團隊所協議並嚴格審核的俱樂部優惠方案。我們與數千家頂級旅遊供應商的關係，使我們能取得難以抗拒的優惠方案。我們的俱樂部及其相關好處，皆圍繞旅遊愛好者的生活方式而建。
Travelzoo 透過多種數位平台，包括電子郵件、網站、社交媒體及行動應用程式，吸引高品質的旅遊愛好者羣眾。我們在 Facebook、Instagram、X 及 WeChat 等社交媒體平台擁有超過 4.7 百萬名追蹤者，截至目前為止，我們的 iOS 與 Android 行動應用程式已被下載 8.1 百萬次。

我們最重要的產品與服務為 Travelzoo 網站（travelzoo.com）、Travelzoo iOS 與 Android 行動應用程式、Top 20® 電子報、獨立電子報、Travelzoo 網路、以及 Jack's Flight Club®。我們的 Travelzoo 網站與電子報包含本地優惠與度假行程的清單，使會員能購買來自本地商家（如水療中心、飯店與餐廳）的優惠憑證。Jack's Flight Club 是一項訂閱服務，為會員提供關於優質機票資訊。
數千家旅遊與本地服務提供者使用我們的廣告與行銷服務。
本公司營收來自廣告與商業、會費及其他來源。

廣告收入主要由（a）旅遊公司為其優惠方案在 Travelzoo 媒體平台刊登所支付的廣告費用、（b）來自我們飯店平台銷售度假憑證與預訂的佣金與收入，以及（c）來自高品質本地企業、銷售本地優惠憑證與娛樂優惠的刊登費用組成。我們通常在電子郵件傳送或點擊後確認廣告收入，此為我們內部平台或第三方平台所追蹤。我們在憑證銷售時確認收入，或在收到直接預訂金額通知時確認收入，或在電子郵件傳送時確認收入。我們在憑證銷售時確認憑證面額的百分比收入，扣除退款允許的減損。

會費收入為 Travelzoo 與 Jack's Flight Club 所支付的訂閱費用。Travelzoo 會費歷來為免費，然而，自 2024 年 1 月 1 日起，Travelzoo 開始為美國、加拿大、英國與德國的新會員收取每年 $40（或當地等值金額）的會費，而截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日的現有會員則免於支付 2024 年的年度費用。自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起，我們將美國新會員的年度會費提高至 $50。對於現有俱樂部會員，新價格將於 2026 年 2 月 1 日後的下一次會費續約時生效。Jack's Flight Club 的訂閱選項為每季、每半年與每年。我們會根據相應的訂閱期間，均勻確認訂閱收入。
其他收入為來自授權協議的授權費用，以及原由 Metaverse Travel Experiences LLC（"MTE"）經營的零售業務，並在收購 MTE 後由本公司取得並持續經營。
我們也將 Travelzoo 產品、服務及智慧財產權授權予授權人，於 (a) 澳洲、紐西蘭及新加坡，以及 (b) 日本及韓國，於各個地區，本公司均有權根據淨銷售額的百分比收取每季 royalty payments。本公司於 2025 年及 2024 年分別認列 royalty 為 68,000 與 71,000 美元。根據授權協議，Travelzoo 在適用地區現有會員仍歸本公司所有。

本公司有四個應報告分部：Travelzoo 北美洲、Travelzoo 歐洲、Jack's Flight Club 與新業務。Travelzoo 北美洲包含本公司在美國與加拿大的營運。Travelzoo 歐洲包含本公司在法國、德國、西班牙與英國的營運。Jack's Flight Club 包含來自 premium 會員的訂閱收入，用以取得並接收透過電子郵件或行動應用程式提供的航班優惠。新業務包含 Travelzoo 的授權業務、Travelzoo META 與 MTE。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Travelzoo 北美洲營運佔營業收入 66%，Travelzoo 歐洲營運佔營業收入 28%，Jack's Flight Club 營運佔營業收入 6%。
本公司主要營業據點位於紐約州紐約市 Madison Avenue 590 號 35 樓，郵遞區號為 10022。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司發行在外的普通股為 10,932,337 股。

Ralph Bartel，為 Travelzoo 的創辦人，為 Ralph Bartel 2005 信託的唯一受益人，該信託為 Azzurro 的控制股東。Azzurro 為本公司最大股東，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，持有本公司發行在外股數約 33.5%。Holger Bartel，本公司全球首席執行官，為 Ralph Bartel 的兄弟，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，未持有本公司發行在外股數。
Travelzoo 登記於 NASDAQ Global Select Market，股票代碼為 "TZOO."

paragraphs: 本報告中所載資訊包含根據 1933 年證券交易法第 27A 節（經修正）及 1934 年證券交易所法第 21E 節（經修正）所定義之向前看陳述。這些向前看陳述係基於 Travelzoo 及我們產業目前的預期、假設、估計及預測。這些向前看陳述受許多風險與不確定性影響，這些風險與不確定性可能導致 Travelzoo 實際結果、表現或成就與向前看陳述所預期或預測者有所不同。本報告中任何非歷史事實陳述之內容，可能被視為向前看陳述。例如，如 "may"、"will"、"should"、"estimates"、"predicts"、"potential"、"continue"、"strategy"、"believes"、"anticipates"、"plans"、"expects"、"intends" 等類似詞彙，係用以識別向前看陳述。Travelzoo 實際結果及某些事件的時間點，可能與向前看陳述所預期者有顯著差異。導致此差異的因素包括，但不僅限於，本報告中 "風險因素" 節所述因素，以及我們其他 SEC 檔案中所討論的風險。本報告中包含的向前看陳述反映本公司管理階層於本報告日的觀點。Travelzoo 不負有更新任何向前看陳述的義務，即使未來有新資訊出現或其它情況發生。

Travelzoo（包括其子公司及附屬公司，以下簡稱 "本公司" 或 "我們"）為一全球網路媒體公司。我們經營 Travelzoo®，這是一個為旅遊愛好者所設立的俱樂部，Jack's Flight Club®，以及 Travelzoo META。我們觸及 30 百萬位旅客。俱樂部會員需支付會費，以獲得由我們全球專門經紀團隊協議並嚴格審核的俱樂部優惠方案。我們與數千家頂級旅遊供應商的關係，使我們能提供難以抗拒的優惠方案。我們的俱樂部及其好處，是根據旅遊愛好者的生活方式所建構的。

Travelzoo 會員過去為免費，然而，自 2024 年起，美國、加拿大、英國及德國的新會員需支付每年 40 美元（或當地等值金額）的年費，而截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日，現有會員的 2024 年年費將被豁免。自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起，我們將美國新會員的年費提高至 50 美元。對於現有會員，新價格將於 2026 年 2 月 1 日後的下一次會費續約時生效。對於來自付費會費的任何訂閱收入，我們會按月比例認列於訂閱期間。
我們也將 Travelzoo 的產品、服務及智慧財產權授權予 (a) 澳洲、紐西蘭及新加坡，以及 (b) 日本及韓國的授權方，於這些地區，本公司有權根據淨銷售額的百分比收取每季 royalty。本公司於 2025 年及 2024 年分別認列 royalty 68,000 美元及 71,000 美元。根據授權協議，Travelzoo 在適用地區的現有會員仍歸本公司所有。
透過 Travelzoo META，我們計畫於 2026 年將 Metaverse 旅遊體驗納入 Travelzoo 俱樂部會員的福利中，使我們能運用及發揮過去幾年所學習與發展的經驗與技術，以服務我們的俱樂部會員。MTE 也持續經營其零售與時尚的傳統業務，此業務包含於本公司合併財務報表中，但對本公司合併財務報表並無重大影響。

本公司根據本公司主要經營決策者管理業務表現的方式，決定其應報告分部。本公司目前有四個應報告營運分部：Travelzoo 北美、Travelzoo 歐洲、Jack's Flight Club 及新業務。Travelzoo 北美包含本公司在美國與加拿大的營運。Travelzoo 歐洲包含本公司在法國、德國、西班牙及英國的營運。Jack's Flight Club 包含來自高階會員的訂閱收入，以取得並接收 Jack's Flight Club 的航班優惠方案，透過電子郵件或行動應用程式。新業務包含 Travelzoo 的授權業務、Travelzoo META 的訂閱服務及 MTE。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日結帳年度，Travelzoo 北美營運佔收入 66%，Travelzoo 歐洲營運佔收入 28%，Jack's Flight Club 佔收入 6%。關於我們業務分部及某些地理區域的財務資訊，請參閱附註 11–分部報告及重要客戶資訊，此資訊已包含於本報告附屬的合併財務報表中，並納入本報告第二部分第 8 項，現已 herein 納入。
在評估本公司財務狀況及營運表現時，管理階層會關注財務與非財務指標，例如本公司通訊稿的會員數量成長、營運毛利、收入成長（絕對值及相對於本公司刊物觸及範圍的成長，以每會員收入及每員工收入作為生產力的衡量標準）。
Travelzoo 品牌及業務的收入主要來自三個類別：廣告與商業、會費及其它。

「廣告與商業」類別主要由以下項目組成：(a) 旅遊公司為在其媒體平台刊登其優惠而支付的廣告費用、(b) 透過我們的酒店平台銷售 Getaways 票據與預訂產生的佣金與收入，以及 (c) 高品質在地商家的刊登費用、Local Deals 票據與娛樂優惠的銷售。廣告費用可能根據受眾覆蓋率、電子郵件簡訊或媒體平台上的置放位置、刊登項目數量、點擊數量及/或實際銷售數量計算。我們通常在電子郵件或點擊送出時確認廣告收入，此為根據我們內部平台或第三方平台追蹤，並在適用的刊登訂單期間內確認，這些刊登訂單通常為一個月至十二個月，且不會自動續約。對於 Getaways 票據，我們在銷售時確認票據面額的百分比作為佣金，扣除未來退款的允許金額。Getaways 廣告商的商家協議通常為十二個月至二十四個月，且不會自動續約。來自在地商家優惠的收入根據銷售票據的面額百分比、實際銷售的佣金或根據受眾覆蓋率計算的刊登費用計算。我們在銷售票據時確認收入，或在收到直接預訂金額通知時，或在電子郵件送出時確認收入。對於 Local Deals 票據，我們在銷售票據時確認票據面額的百分比作為收入，扣除退款的允許金額。Local Deals 的刊登訂單與商家協議通常為一個月至十二個月，且不會自動續約。
在某些情況下，本公司會預先從客戶與合作夥伴（例如酒店或水療合作夥伴）批量購買票據或酒店存貨（以信用額度、票據或禮券形式）。

headings: 與本公司財務狀況及商業模式相關之風險
本公司無法保證將會獲利。
營運成果之波動可能對本公司股票價格產生負面影響。
產品線擴張可能導致額外成本超過收入，並可能引發股票價格之更大波動。
本公司憑證產品可能因競爭及憑證需求之變化而受到負面影響。
商譽、長期投資及長壽命資產之減損會對本公司營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司業務可能因依賴數位平台及搜尋引擎演算法或其他流量產生安排之變動而受到負面影響。
消費者使用行動裝置之趨勢持續產生挑戰。
本公司可能面臨額外的稅務負擔。
州及地方稅法的不利適用可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司商業模式可能無法適應市場的變化。
若本公司無法留住現有廣告客戶或增加新廣告客戶，將會對本公司營業收入及業務造成損害。
若本公司廣告及內容無法符合會員的需要與期待，將可能對本公司業務造成影響。
「Cookie」、「pixel」及追蹤技術相關法律可能對本公司營運方式產生負面影響。
本公司報告的觸及率可能高於實際觸及率，且可能無法反映活躍潛在客戶人數。
本公司可能無法取得足夠資金以支撐業務成長，且權益或債務融資可能在不利條件下進行。
本公司可能對經濟衰退或其他總體經濟情勢或事件較為敏感，這些事件可能影響旅遊產業整體。
本公司營運可能因自然災害或其他重大事故的發生而受到顯著影響。
本公司面臨與付款及詐欺相關的風險。
本公司財務結果可能因美國一般會計準則的變更而受到不利影響，且本公司可能因調整會計系統及程序以符合相關規定而產生顯著成本。
與本公司市場及策略相關的風險
本公司國際營運可能導致營運虧損，並面臨其他重大風險。
本公司可能無法持續提升本公司品牌名稱的知名度。
若本公司無法留住現有會員或取得新會員，將對本公司營業收入及業務造成損害。
我們可能無法吸引旅遊與休閒公司或網際網路使用者，若我們無法持續改善並發展我們產品與服務的內容與功能。
若我們無法聘請並留住高技能人員，將會影響我們的業務與成長。
激烈的競爭可能不利於我們達成或維持市場佔有率，並影響我們的營運獲利能力。
我們可能無法取得我們所依賴的第三方技術。
併購、投資、授權協議及合資企業可能會導致營運困難、股權稀釋，以及其他有害後果，這些後果可能不利於我們的業務與營運成果。
預購禮券與飯店存貨可能會為我們的業務創造額外的風險或負債。
因為我們是根據訂閱期間認列俱樂部會員資格的營業收入，因此經濟衰退或成長的情況可能不會立即反映在我們的營運結果上。
與法律不確定性相關的風險
本公司可能因股票價格波動而面臨股東提起的證券違規訴訟。
本公司受全球各國法律及法規約束，相關法規的變更可能增加本公司成本，並個別或整體不利影響本公司業務。
信用卡法案（CARD Act）及類似州級與外國法律可能對本公司之在地活動與度假業務造成損害。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。本公司業務、財務狀況與營運結果可能受許多因素影響，包括目前已知或未知的因素，包括但不限於下列所列因素，任何一個或數個因素可能直接或間接導致本公司實際財務狀況與營運結果與過去或預期未來財務狀況與營運結果有重大差異。任何或全部下列風險因素，以及影響我們營運結果的其他變數，可能對我們業務或財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響，可能導致本公司股票市價下跌或造成本公司股票價格大幅波動，屆時您的普通股價值可能下跌。當您閱讀前瞻性陳述時，也應留意這些風險因素。

我們的季度與年度營運結果未來可能因許多因素而大幅波動，這些因素可能影響我們的收入或費用。您不應依賴我們各季度營運結果的比較，因為這些比較不被視為未來表現的指標。影響季度結果的因素包括：會員取得的投資程度、消費者退款率；因預測客戶需求困難而導致資源配置與客戶需求不匹配；總體經濟狀況（被認為或實際）的變化，可能影響消費者支出；我們產品與服務以及競爭對手產品與服務的推出、發展、時程、競爭性價格與市場接受度；我們吸引、聘僱與留住關鍵人員的能力；我們維持商家與會員滿意度並持續吸引高品質商家與會員的能力；我們管理預計成長的能力；我們鼓勵會員與我們產品與服務互動並將非付費會員轉為俱樂部會員的能力；我們鼓勵俱樂部會員續約與留存的能力；以及技術困難或系統停機問題。
我們可能因總體經濟狀況、表現與/或消費者需求下降而大幅減少營運費用。我們可能因特定期間內看到獨特機會而大幅增加營運費用，例如加速取得新會員或現有會員的參與。如果任何季度收入低於預期，且我們無法迅速減少營運費用，我們的營運結果將低於預期，股票價格可能下跌。

2024年1月1日，我們轉為收費會員模式，現有Travelzoo會員在該年度結束前仍可享受原有權益。自那之後，我們已推出額外的俱樂部會員權益。2022年3月，我們宣佈成立我們的元宇宙業務。我們計畫在2026年將元宇宙旅遊體驗納入Travelzoo會員權益。紅利產品通常有14天的退款政策，但我們未來可能修改或更新產品，包括退款期限，或投資於升級技術或新技術或產品。這些產品改良與擴張可能導致短期成本增加，並在長遠內增加成本結構，這可能高於追加收入。如果我們未能成功將這些計畫商業化，我們的業務與財務結果可能受到不利影響。如果我們無法吸引會員使用我們的產品，或我們的廣告商不接受我們產品的變更，我們的財務結果可能受到影響。我們無法保證任何產品將產生我們預期的效益，且不會導致額外成本。

我們的本地優惠與旅遊產品包括直接向消費者銷售紅利，以宣傳商家提供的促銷活動。在某些情況下，我們會預購紅利/酒店房間。紅利格式可能需要額外投資以維持與擴展業務。我們的紅利通常有14天的退款期，也提供額外費用選項。然而，自2021年以前，我們觀察到紅利產品的需求普遍下降。未來，本公司可能戰略性地放棄提供額外費用選項或紅利產品，或可能進一步投資紅利產品以擴展其產品範疇。雖然我們持續進化策略，但我們不總是能成功，紅利需求可能下降或退款率上升，可能對收入造成不利影響。
